translations.web: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Be not afraid because of them; for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith Jehovah.
